topic: Reviewing India tickets and client issues
summary_markdown:
The conversation started with a request to review tickets related to India. Later, the discussion shifted to technical issues regarding client data and reporting.

One participant provided a link to an existing ticket (JCDEC-705). When discussing a client interaction, it was determined that the client did not have virtual boxes.

Technical fixes were discussed: one issue was resolved and would be deployed to staging. Another issue involved 'reach' not matching with a map, which could be fixed but would change numbers for all clients on maps. This potential change required further consultation with someone named Esben before proceeding.
decisions: The proposed fix involving reach/map discrepancies that changes client numbers must be cleared with Esben.
action_items: Deploy the resolved code to staging environment.
